BiblicalUsage: Ara is named once, as a son of Jether among the sons of Asher. His name sits in the genealogy of the tribe, one of the sons of Jether beside Jephunneh and Pispah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in the record of Asher is a person God counted, even when the story gives us nothing more.
